name: campaign_publication_plan
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

outcome.description: Campaign outcome; 'verified' is required for a non-draft publish. Falls back to 'incomplete' if not a non-empty string.

requestedDraft.description: Explicit request to publish as a draft; forces draft=true when exactly true.

testState.description: Test cycle state, echoed back as testCycleState; falls back to 'not_run' if not a string.

testsPassed.description: Whether the final test cycle passed; must be exactly true for a non-draft publish.

tested.description: Commit/ref produced by the final test cycle. Used as the publish head when non-blank.

committed.description: Commit/ref to fall back to as the publish head when 'tested' is blank.

agentAuthoredTest.description: Whether the final test cycle accepted a coding-agent-authored test (no pre-existing test covered the change). Forces draft=true when exactly true, even if testsPassed is also true, as defense in depth alongside the red/green check that already proved the test isn't vacuous.

draft.description: True unless outcome is 'verified' and requestedDraft is not true and testsPassed is exactly true and agentAuthoredTest is not true.

outcome.description: Resolved campaign outcome; 'incomplete' when outcome was not a non-empty string.

testCycleState.description: Resolved test cycle state; 'not_run' when testState was not a string.

testsPassed.description: True only when input testsPassed was exactly true.

agentAuthoredTest.description: Echoes whether a coding-agent-authored test was used; true only when input agentAuthoredTest was exactly true.

agentAuthoredTestNote.description: A fixed markdown note flagging the agent-authored test for PR-body visibility when agentAuthoredTest is true; empty string otherwise.
